profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Experienced software engineer with strong focus on continuous growth and personal challenges. Takes particular interest in designing and building sustainable, secure software systems through clear documentation, technical debt avoidance/mitigation, and well structured, testable code. Emphasizes clear communication and knowledge sharing amongst each team I have been a part of. Extensive background in designing and building large scale backend systems with AWS technologies (particularly serverless) using agile methodology and collaboration with several business layers between product, UX, customers/stakeholders, and management/leadership.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer with Google Cloud SQL EngProd team

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Worked with a small team in an agile environment to deliver a new customer-facing case automation service to improve operational efficiency within support. Previously, led design and coordinated team's development efforts for an internal web-facing analytics tools to provide insights to support engineers aimed at improving overall support performance.

Primarily worked with NPM and Typescript/Javascript, as well as React, to deliver cloud-first, sustainable, testable code, with a strong preference for serverless technologies as a means of prioritizing development velocity and high availability.

positions.title: System Development Engineer
positions.description: Develop internal tools using various programming languages and frameworks; audit logs, service metrics, and code quality for supportability; work with development teams to drive operational efficiency for issues along the digital publishing pipeline.

positions.title: Assistant Academic Software Developer
positions.description: Developed various web-based application plugins for the school's Moodle server using PHP and worked with MySQL databases writing simple database queries, all hosted on a LAMP architecture.

company.name: University of Portland Academic Technology Services

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Collaborated with a researcher and a UX designer to build an ASP.NET application that distributes customizable surveys from an Azure SQL backend to medical participants and stores their responses using Microsoft’s HealthVault SDK. Produced C# server code and designed a cross-browser-compatible UI using extensive JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS code. Also worked to satisfy security & policy requirements within the application to protect sensitive user information.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Expanded on MakeFest project using WPF (Visual C#) and Windows Store app development libraries. Consumed webservices using JSON APIs and ran multi-threaded processes to retrieve data from online sources.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Developed mobile banking application using Android and eclipse IDE. Learned fundamentals of design practices and project structure in Android applications.

positions.title: Basketball Official
positions.description: Refereed basketball games for kids ages 9-14.
